reason: 45 minutes a day just isn't real for me when the baby naps for 30 minutes on a good day. I might tap into the free 5 weeks, but I'd probably drop off and go back to free YouTube rather than pay for the next bit.
objection: I can't find 45 minutes a day with a baby, and I already get workouts free on YouTube and Instagram, so why pay?
would_change_my_mind: Short 10 to 15 minute sessions I can finish in one nap, and actually sticking with the free 5 weeks and feeling my core and pelvic floor improve.
